versions.content: AUTOSAR RTE shall support scheduling of executable entities on defined events Type: Valid Description: The RTE shall support a set of events which can be used to start executable entities, and offer the software com ponents and BSW the necessary interfaces. Note: The offered events shall be based on current automotive requirements Rationale: Executable entities do need a reason to be run, in the simplest case a periodic trigger. This needs to be organized and handled by the RTE Use Case: Start executable entities because of periodic events, because data has arrived, because an error has occurred etc. Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: --
